book.name: Zenasis - Stat blo ebriting
book.title: Buk blo Zenasis stori baut stat blo ebriting

content: Da pladwata i godaun
Bat God i bin mata tingbaut po Noa ane ebridem animal wea i bin wea Noa insaid lo da bot. God i bin meke win po go antap wea da prapa big pladwata ane da wata i bin stat po godaun.
Ebridem spring blo da prapa bigwata andanit wea lan ane skai wea i bin open wase winda, bin satem, ane rein i bin stap prom poldaun.
Da prapa big pladwata i bin stat po godaun slowan. Wa! Wen i bin kese 150 dei,
paib mant prom wen da bigplad i bin stat, da bigbot i bin kam ane pas antap lo big ai maunten, kolem Maunt Ararat.
Da mina big pladwata i bin kip godaun ane apta tu ane ap mant, dem ai pat blo dem nada maunten i bin stat po kamaut.
Wen i bin kese end blo da poti dei, Noa i bin opene winda wea em bin mekem lo da bot,
ane Noa bin lego wan blaik krou go ausaid wea da winda. Da krou no bin kambaigen po da bot bat bin mata plai stap ausaid prom da bot antil da prapa big pladwata i bin drai.
Apta Noa i bin lego da krou, Noa bin lego wan dab po luk ip em ken paine draiples.
Bat da dab i no bin paine eni sidaun ples lo graun ane em bin kambaigen po da bot bikoz i stil bin gad wata. Noa i bin pute an blo em go ausaid po teke da dab kam insaid po da bot.
Noa i bin weit po nada seben dei, den em bin lego gen da dab go ausaid prom da bot.
Ane wen i bin naittaim da dab i bin kambaigen kare wan niu lip blo olibtri lo maut blo em. Den Noa i bin wantaim sabe da prapa big pladwata i bin klostu po drai.
Noa bin weit po nada seben dei ane em bin lego gen da dab go ausaid ane distaim da dab i no bin kambaigen.
Noa i bin kese 601 iya oul, diswan i ten ane ap mant apta da big pladwata i bin stat. Den Noa i bin opene doa po luk go ausaid. Wen Noa i bin luk go ausaid da graun i bin stat po kam drai.
Nada tu mant bin pas ane da lan i bin prapa drai.
God i meke gudting melen em ane pipol
Den God i bin spik po Noa,
‘Yupla ebriwan, go ausaid prom da bot.
Lego ebridem dipren animal ane pizin go ausaid prom da bot solong dempla go brid ane kam plenti ebriwea lo da lan.’
Wa! Noa i bin go ausaid prom da bot wea oman blo em, ol boi blo em, ane ol oman blo boi blo em.
Ane ebridem dipren dipren animal ane pizin, ol bin kamaut tutu kam ausaid.
Den Noa i bin bilde wan olta po mata wosip da AntapGod, ane Noa i bin teke sam dem rait animal ane dem rait pizin ane em bin kilem ane bane demwan antap wea olta po wosip da AntapGod.

Ane da smel blo sakripais i bin meke da AntapGod pil nadakain api ane em i bin spik po emselp, ‘Yagar! Nomo gen ai go kerse da ert. Yagar! Nomo gen ai go smas ane distroi ebri laipsamting wea ai bin mekem, nomata wen dem pipol i kip tingk ol nugudwei ane wen pipol meke ol nugudting prom wen dempla smol.

Da taim blo laip blo ert i go mata kipgo ane no stap. I go gad taim po plante ol gadan kaikai ane taim wen dem kaikai redi po kaikai. I go gad taim blo kol ane taim blo ot, ane i go gad taim blo rein ane taim blo no rein, ane taim blo naittaim ane taim blo deitaim.’
